sections.title: GM12 Helix Generation
sections.text: Generates a real helical centerline from a radius and either pitch (optionally with turns) or turns+height. hand right/left, startPhase an angular expression, tolerance a positive curve tolerance (default 0.01 mm). An optional section profile ref sweeps the generated helix. The result is a sampled helix plus fitted NURBS recipe, never a native Coil; native persistent 3D helical path insertion is a declared gap.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, success/status/operation/documentIdentity, units:{length:cm,angle:rad}, frame:{space:component}, associativity:recipeRegeneration, radius/pitch/turns/height/hand/startPhase, arcLength, curvature, curvatureRadius, samplePoints, representation:recipe (or blocked for representation:native) and provenance:GM12.

examples.label: Right-handed helix with pitch and turns
examples.requires: A selected component; no existing geometry.
examples.output: result.arcLength is turns * sqrt(pitch^2 + (2*pi*radius)^2); result.samplePoints feed visualization.

verified: Recipe representation, native Coil never claimed
bugs: Native persistent 3D helical path insertion not exposed by installed SDK

sections.title: GM12 Spring Geometry
sections.text: Composes a helical centerline with a wire section. wireDiameter and meanDiameter are length expressions with meanDiameter > wireDiameter; activeCoils drives stiffness, totalCoils drives mass and solid height; freeLength must exceed solid height. endStyle plain/ground/open; ground/plain ends are recipe representations only — no native end-coil geometry is cut or generated (declared native Coil gap). Returns wire length, mass, solid height and stiffness alongside the generated geometry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, geometry refs, outerDiameter/innerDiameter, wireLength, mass, volume, solidHeight, solidHeightMargin, pitch, stiffness, endStyle, representation:recipe and assumptions. associativity:recipeRegeneration.

examples.label: Ground compression spring
examples.requires: A selected component; no existing geometry.
examples.output: result.stiffness uses active coils; result.solidHeight is totalCoils * wireDiameter.

verified: Active vs total coil split for stiffness/mass
Ground/plain ends are recipe representations, not native geometry
bugs: Ground-end geometry and the wire-section sweep are declared native gaps (no persistent native helical path)

sections.title: GM12 Spring Evaluation
sections.text: Read-only engineering evaluation. k = G*d^4/(8*D^3*n) with n the active coils; solid height = totalCoils * wireDiameter; mass uses total coils and wire length. installedLength and compressedLength (or deflection) produce forces; energy follows from the linear law. shearModulus and density accept unit-bearing pressure/density quantities.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, stiffness:{value,units:N/mm}, wireLength, mass, solidHeight, solidHeightMargin, freeLength, installedLength, compressedLength, pitch, forces[] and model assumptions. status pass.

examples.label: P054 spring stiffness and forces
examples.output: result.stiffness.value is approximately 0.195821 N/mm for these inputs.

bugs: Linear model only; no buckling or fatigue

sections.title: GM12 Spring Configuration
sections.text: Read-only configuration check for installed/compressed state, guide clearance and material-volume conservation. A compressedLength below solid height fails (material volume would change silently). A guide {kind:rod|tube,diameter} checks rod/tube clearance; a freeLength/meanDiameter slenderness above 4 is reported as unknown.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, configuredState (solidHeight, solidHeightMargin, installed/compressed length) and checks[]. status pass or fail.

examples.label: Compressed state with guide rod
examples.output: result.checks include material-volume and guide-rod with margins.
